rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.003, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.02, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-11 STEP-SIZE probe (revert optimizer). iter-10 tv_optimizer gd->adam COLLAPSED hr 0.3596->0.0 (adam lr=0.01 destabilized the data term: data 0.80->1.16, TV crashed 76007->18685, ssim 0.74) => GD is required; revert to gd. Earlier GD logs showed the TV term still descending at iter-1000 (under-converged). ONE knob: tv_lr 0.01->0.02 (2x GD step; keep gd, lambda=3e-3, 1000 iters, gamma=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: a larger GD step lets the TV objective descend further within 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.3596; if it destabilizes the data term (hr drops) then lr=0.01 was near the GD stability limit and I revert + add iterations instead. Budget: ~870s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
